airzone_wizard.steps: Add a gateway, step by step
airzone_wizard.search_help: Moli searches your network for compatible gateways. Keep your gateway switched on.
airzone_wizard.search_wait: This may take a few seconds.
airzone_wizard.manual_help: Enter your gateway’s address. Moli will check it for you.
airzone_wizard.choose_help: Make sure this is the right gateway before continuing.
airzone_wizard.confirm_help: See its zones and readings in Moli. You can organise their names and rooms afterwards.
airzone_wizard.observation: Read only: your heating settings stay unchanged.
airzone_wizard.scan_help: Searching does not change any equipment.
airzone_wizard.saved_help: Your gateway is saved. Its zones appear as their first readings arrive.
airzone_wizard.empty_help: Check that your gateway is switched on and reachable on your network. You can also enter its address.
airzone_wizard.incomplete: The search could not cover the whole network. If a gateway is missing, add it by its address.
airzone_wizard.scan_busy: Wait a moment before searching again.
airzone_wizard.discovery_pin: Your Moli code allows a search for gateways on the local network. No equipment will be changed.
airzone_wizard.installation_help: Find your gateways and manage their connection to Moli.
